study: Hanley et al. 2016, Let's Think Secondary Science (LTSS), EEF
delivery_evidence: Let's Think Forum provided one day of (regional) face-to-face training plus three support sessions per year to the LTSS science teachers (Intervention description; 'observation of a regional training day'). Online references in the report concern test/questionnaire administration, not PD delivery.
test_alignment_evidence: Outcomes are broad independent standardized tests: KS3 science SATs paper (primary) and GL Assessment Progress Tests in English (PTE) and Maths (PIM); not tailored to LTSS (Tables 3-4, p.18-19).
curriculum_evidence: LTSS is a defined programme of 19 one-hour lessons with lesson plans, PowerPoint slides, video tutorials and sort cards, delivered to students 'instead of their usual science lessons'—a packaged instructional-materials/lesson program (Intervention description).
outcome_timing_evidence: All effect sizes measured at the end of Year 8 (June-July 2015), the end of the two-year intervention (Tables 3-5; timepoint 'post, end of Year 8').
